questions.instructions: Read the text. Choose every answer that the text supports. There is more than one.

content.passage: Coral reefs cover a very small part of the ocean floor, yet they are home to about a quarter of all known marine species. Reefs also protect coastlines by breaking up strong waves. Rising sea temperatures cause corals to lose the algae that feed them, a process known as bleaching.
content.question: According to the text, which of the following are true about coral reefs?

options.label: A
options.body: They support a large share of marine species.

options.label: B
options.body: They cover most of the ocean floor.

options.label: C
options.body: They reduce the force of waves on coasts.

options.label: D
options.body: Bleaching is caused by cold water.

questions.explanation: A matches "a quarter of all known marine species". C matches "breaking up strong waves". The text says reefs cover a small part of the floor and bleaching comes from rising temperatures.
questions.learning_objective: Find several facts stated in a text.

questions.instructions: Read the text. Choose every answer that the text supports. There is more than one.

content.passage: Night shifts can disturb the body's internal clock. Workers on long-term night schedules report more digestive problems and poorer sleep quality. Some employers now offer brighter lighting during shifts and blackout blinds for daytime rest, which appear to reduce these effects.
content.question: Which measures does the writer mention to reduce the effects of night work?

options.label: C
options.body: Blackout blinds for sleeping in the day

questions.explanation: Only lighting and blackout blinds are mentioned as measures.
questions.learning_objective: Separate stated measures from ideas that are not in the text.

questions.instructions: Read the text. Choose the one answer that the text supports.

content.passage: The town market opens every Saturday from 8 am to 1 pm. Most stalls sell fresh fruit and vegetables, but there are also stalls selling bread and handmade soap.
content.question: What is the main thing sold at the market?

questions.explanation: "Most stalls" sell fruit and vegetables. Bread and soap are "also" sold, so they are not the main thing.
questions.learning_objective: Identify the main idea versus extra details.
